Let initial savings = x and expenditure = 3x, so income = 3x + x = 4x.

New income = 4x X 1.25 = 5x.

New savings = x X 1.20 = 1.2x.

New expenditure = New income − New savings = 5x − 1.2x = 3.8x.

Percentage increase in expenditure = [(3.8x − 3x) / 3x] X 100

= (0.8x / 3x) X 100 ≈ 26.67%.

Answer: Approximately 26.67%
